article.title: 更進新聞：Daydream推出穿搭助理，參與商戶支援一鍵結帳
article.summary: Daydream推出時裝購物助理，可按用戶的場合、尺碼偏好和預算建議搭配，並在背景追蹤商品。
highlights: 用戶可要求助理留意降價或品牌推出新品。
購買須顧客批准，一鍵結帳只適用參與商戶。
article.why: 時裝零售商可檢查尺寸、場合和庫存資料，讓商品有機會回應具體穿搭需求。
article.next_step: 逐項比對商品頁及商品資料源的尺碼名稱、價格及庫存，並查詢商戶結帳資格。
article.detail: Daydream表示，助理在iOS應用程式和短訊開放。顧客可把商品存入清單，比較配搭，並重複使用上載的照片作虛擬試穿。用戶同意後，助理亦可利用衣櫃和行事曆資訊作建議。對零售團隊而言，試穿、商品建議及結帳各有適用情境，可分開檢查商品資料和參與條件。
article.title_en: Update: Daydream launches styling agent with checkout at participating retailers
article.summary_en: Daydream launched a fashion shopping agent that suggests outfits by occasion, fit preferences and budget and can track products in the background.
highlights_en: Shoppers can ask the agent to watch for sales or new products from a brand.
One-click checkout is limited to participating partners and requires shopper approval.
article.why_en: Fashion retailers can check their fit, occasion and inventory data so products can answer more specific styling requests.
article.next_step_en: Compare sizing labels, prices and stock in your catalog feed with the product pages and ask whether your store is eligible for checkout.
article.detail_en: Daydream says the agent is available in its iOS app and by text. Shoppers can save items, compare outfits and reuse an uploaded photo for virtual try-on. With opt-in, the agent can also use closet and calendar information in suggestions. Retail teams can check catalog coverage and partner eligibility separately for try-on, recommendations and checkout.
article.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
article.followup: 9月16日本刊報道Daydream從手機相簿找商品。這次加入持續追蹤、穿搭建議及參與商戶結帳。
article.followup_en: Our September 16 issue covered discovery from the camera roll. The new agent adds ongoing tracking, outfit suggestions and partner checkout.
